name: Pet journal: XP from a win levels a pet up, carries the rest over and heals it
contract: Phase 3 of the pet battle port, upstream's XP rule. A level-1 Timber Wolf (69) that beats a level-5 enemy gains
that level's 70 XP (coa_pet_xp); level 1 needs 1 x 50, so it reaches level 2 with 20 of the 2 x 55 = 110 XP
level 2 needs. A level-up restores full health. Granting an owned species again is refused.
